name: Pilates With Leah
address: The Irish Centre, 205 Wheelers Lane, Kings Heath, Birmingham
notes: Candlelit mat Pilates in Kings Heath, 100% recommend from 5 reviews. Very visual class concept - ideal for reels.

name: Respira Pilates Birmingham
address: Edgbaston and Kings Heath, Birmingham (plus Zoom)
notes: 100% recommend from 10 reviews. Runs both in-person and online/Zoom classes - already set up to produce video.

name: Kings Heath Yoga (Clare Preston)
notes: Beginner-friendly Iyengar plus a women-only class at published prices (8-12 GBP). CAUTION: site prints the number as 0786 165 4472 - normalise to 07861 654472.

name: On The Mind
notes: Courses, taster sessions and corporate training across Leeds and Harrogate. Corporate/B2B video is the premium angle.

name: Leeds Mindfulness (Steve Hart)
address: Kirkstall Abbey and Mabgate Mill, Leeds
notes: Runs retreats and one-to-one support. Returning with new events in 2027 - long lead time, so worth an early relationship.

name: Nordic Balance St James's
notes: Gym, pool, spa, squash plus physio, osteo, chiro, podiatry and shockwave. Open 6:30am-11pm daily. Huge service range = big content need.

name: Southgate Physio
address: 10 Onslow Parade, Hampden Square, Southgate, London
notes: North London sports injury clinic, disabled-friendly facilities. Condition-specific service pages ready to repurpose.

name: Purple Mighty Mobile Massage
notes: Mobile massage business - site says check availability and book through WhatsApp. Strong fit for social video, since it is home-visit based.

name: Skin Clinix
notes: Chorlton skin clinic, Mon-Sat, publishes landline and mobile (07399 555767). CAUTION: their own site has a typo in the email on one page - use skinclinix@gmail.com.
